_comment: Fixed sentences statemachine.py hands a round to send the user. Copy this file to add a language. language must equal report_language in shared/skill_deploy.toml, ignoring case. A sentence may be {"one": ..., "other": ...}, picked by whether {n} is 1. A key a file leaves out falls back to this file. Keep toast rules in mind, so no double quotes and no colons.

stalled.one: Gmail check has not finished a round in 1 hour, mail may be piling up, check by hand
stalled.other: Gmail check has not finished a round in {n} hours, mail may be piling up, check by hand

notices.stuck: Backlog catch-up is stuck, needs manual attention
notices.backlog: Older mail is still being scanned

missingId.one: 1 item has no id and cannot be tracked
missingId.other: {n} items have no id and cannot be tracked
